keywords: Error and accuracy 2.Data handling 3.Random variable & Probability distribution 4.Statistical processing 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) how to analyze and evaluate data obtained from experimental surveys using statistical methods. (2) the mathematical meaning of the analyzed and evaluated data. (3) how to use Excel to perform statistical processing and create graphs of statistical results.(Class management and a special lecture will be given in cooperation with local residents and companies.)
advice: This is a basic course in statistics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Error and accuracy of measured results. 2. Normal distribution. 3. Basics of descriptive statistics and their mathematical concepts. 4. Data analysis methods using statistics. Students are expected to understand that the measurement data in an experiment have variation and that this variation is a variable associated with a stochastic phenomenon. Students are expected to understand the normal distribution as a common probability distribution function. Students are expected to learn statistics in data analysis, including correlation and regression analysis. Students are expected to analyze data using Excel (computer spreadsheet software). Students are expected to complete the exercises on their own and not copy/consult with others. Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher
books: Statistics for Bioscience and Chemistry (Kanazawa Institute of Technology)
requiredKnowledge: Mathematical skills learned in Integrated Math. and Science for Bioscience and Chemistry I. Basic computer skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the characteristics of data types and errors.
Be able to process basic descriptive statistics.
Be able to properly express descriptive statistics results in tables and graphs.
Be able to process data using Excel.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for statistics.
Be able to understand the contents of each class,work on assigned tasks,and attend every class.
